tasks.label: create-bin-sram
tasks.command: llvm-objcopy -O binary zig-out/firmware/synth.elf zig-out/firmware/synth.bin && echo 'Created synth.bin'

tasks.label: create-bin-flash
tasks.command: llvm-objcopy -O binary zig-out/firmware/synth.elf zig-out/firmware/synth.bin && echo 'Created synth.bin'

tasks.label: program-flash-openocd
tasks.command: openocd -s /usr/local/share/openocd/scripts -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c 'program ./zig-out/firmware/synth.elf verify reset exit' && echo success!

tasks.label: program-sram-openocd
tasks.command: zig build synth -Doptimize=safe -Dmemory=sram && openocd -s /usr/local/share/openocd/scripts -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c 'program ./zig-out/firmware/synth.elf verify reset exit' && echo success!
